QUOTE: On GCC/Clang-style compilers, `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` is defined when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is on (it is by default, `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:52`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM together with a compiler check (`defined(__GNUC__)` and `__ARMCC_VERSION`), so it is derived. It never says outright that CT_ASM is not a config entry, but that follows from the description.
